name: TC-VHR-03: Check Vehicle Report lead requests OTP successfully on Vehicle Report
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/VehicleReport.cy.js#UsedTruck - VehicleReport [en] — Vehicle Report TC-VHR-03: Check Vehicle Report lead requests OTP successfully on Vehicle Report
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-VHR-03
**Title:** Check Vehicle Report lead requests OTP successfully on Vehicle Report
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Vehicle Report page, enter a sample vehicle registration number, click Check Vehicle Report to open its Get Information lead form (a distinct form from Check Offers), fill name, mobile and truck brand, and submit. This form is OTP-gated — there is no configured test OTP in this repo, so completion is verified up to the OTP screen, not full end-to-end submission.

**Expected Result:**
An OTP verification screen (with an Enter OTP field) appears, confirming the lead request succeeded. The submitted name is tagged with a page/CTA identifier for CRM traceability.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Vehicle Report page
2. Enter a sample vehicle registration number
3. Click Check Vehicle Report to open its lead form
4. Fill name, mobile and truck brand
5. Submit and verify the OTP screen appears
